facts.title: SK hynix at FMS 2026: V10 375-layer 4D NAND and Next-Generation Memory Architecture for AI
facts.event_hint: SK hynix FMS 2026 showcase of its first wafer-bonded 375-layer 4D NAND (V10) wafer and NAND server-memory products for AI, August 4-6 2026, Santa Clara.
facts.problem: AI training, large-scale inference and Agentic AI drive exponentially growing data volumes, demanding higher density and lower-power NAND tiers; no single memory product can meet combined bandwidth and capacity needs, motivating a Tiered Memory architecture (HBM/DRAM/NAND(HBF)/SSD).
facts.mechanism: 375-layer 4D NAND built with wafer bonding (SK hynix's first NAND product to apply wafer bonding) for high performance plus low power; 1Tb TLC devices offered in a 2-Channel 32-Die Package (first TLC to support it) and a smaller-footprint 334B QDP package; positioned as a NAND/HBF tier between HBM and SSD for AI data centers.

evidence.claim: SK hynix displayed a 375-layer 4D NAND Wafer, its first NAND product to apply wafer bonding, delivering both high performance and low power consumption across device environments including AI data centers.
evidence.condition: Exhibit wafer shown at FMS 2026 'The Smart Edge' zone
evidence.source_locator: Section 'From AI Accelerators & Servers to Edge Devices: A Comprehensive Memory Portfolio' / The Smart Edge - '375-layer 4D NAND Wafer'

evidence.claim: The 375-layer 1Tb TLC 154B 32DP is the first TLC-based product to support a 2-Channel 32-Die Package.
evidence.source_locator: Section 'From AI Accelerators & Servers to Edge Devices' - '375-layer 1Tb TLC 154B 32DP'

evidence.claim: The 375-layer 1Tb TLC 334B QDP improves space efficiency with a 13.5x12.5mm footprint versus a conventional 4-Channel Package at 14x18mm.
evidence.source_locator: Section 'From AI Accelerators & Servers to Edge Devices' - '375-layer 1Tb TLC 334B QDP'

evidence.claim: The QLC-based PS1101 high-capacity eSSD lineup delivers about 55% higher performance than the previous 176-layer generation, and sample shipments to major CSP customers begin in August 2026.
evidence.condition: QLC eSSD, developed sequentially by form factor
evidence.source_locator: Section 'From AI Accelerators & Servers to Edge Devices' - PS1101 eSSD lineup paragraph

facts.evaluation_context: FMS 2026 exhibition, Santa Clara Convention Center, August 4-6 2026. Facts are booth product displays and vendor-stated specifications, not benchmark results. Keynote framed Tiered Memory (HBM, DRAM, NAND(HBF), SSD) for Agentic AI; SK hynix delivered 12 Technical Sessions including 'Why, What, How HBF?' and an HBF panel with Google and Sandisk.
facts.limitations: The evidence pack truncates mid-sentence at 'The 375-layer 4D NAND is characterized by 2.', so the headline performance-per-watt multiplier (summarized as ~2.5x vs prior generation) is not fully visible in the evidence text. No absolute sequential/random bandwidth (GB/s, IOPS), P/E endurance, write amplification, access latency, or cost/bit numbers appear in the visible evidence.
facts.project_relevance: Directly feeds storage_media density/power/timing evidence: the 375-layer node and first wafer-bonded 4D NAND advance the NAND density curve, and PS1101 sampling in August 2026 gives a concrete volume-timing signal for QLC eSSD in AI data centers. Relevant to whether media innovation converts into deployable AI-storage gains, but quantitative bandwidth/endurance are still needed to confirm the gain.
source_notes: fetch_status=LOCAL_SOURCE; primary vendor newsroom URL https://news.skhynix.com/en/fms-2026/.

Evidence text is truncated at the V10 4D NAND characterization sentence; the ~2.5x performance-per-watt figure cited in the source summary is not fully present in the visible evidence pack and is requested via evidence_gaps.

evidence_gaps.question: What is the exact performance-per-watt (or power-efficiency) multiplier of the 375-layer 4D NAND versus the previous generation, and under what workload or test condition?
